title: 목적 말하기: -(으)러 가다/오다
summary: Say why you are going or coming somewhere with V-(으)러 가다/오다/다니다.
objective: Say why you go or come somewhere with V-(으)러 가다/오다/다니다, build the right form for every kind of verb stem, and avoid three common mistakes.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel: 보다 → 보러, 쉬다 → 쉬러, 공부하다 → 공부하러
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm going to see a movie this weekend.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant (not ㄹ): 먹다 → 먹으러, 읽다 → 읽으러, 찾다 → 찾으러
forms.exampleMeaning: Let's go and eat lunch together.

forms.when: The stem ends in ㄹ. Add only -러, not -으러: 놀다 → 놀러, 만들다 → 만들러
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend came over to my house to hang out.

forms.when: Some verbs ending in ㄷ (듣다, 걷다, 묻다) change ㄷ to ㄹ, then add -으러: 듣다 → 들으러
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm going to a concert to listen to music.

forms.when: Some verbs ending in ㅂ (돕다, 줍다, 굽다) change ㅂ to 우, then add -러: 돕다 → 도우러
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm going to the countryside to help my grandmother.

forms.when: Use 오다 when you are already at the place, or when someone comes to where you are.
forms.exampleMeaning: (At the post office) I came to pick up a package.

forms.when: Use 다니다 when you go somewhere regularly, e.g. every week.
forms.exampleMeaning: I go to the swimming pool to learn how to swim.

watchOut: 공부하러 도서관에서 앉아요 (X) → 공부하러 도서관에 가요 (O): After -(으)러, use a verb of movement: 가다, 오다 or 다니다. Use the particle 에 for the place you go to.
은행에 가러 가요 (X) → 돈 찾으러 은행에 가요 (O): Don't put 가다 or 오다 in front of -러. Use the verb for what you will do there.
예쁘러 미용실에 가요 (X) → 머리 자르러 미용실에 가요 (O): -(으)러 only works with action verbs. You cannot use it with adjectives like 예쁘다 or 좋다.
놀으러 (X) → 놀러 (O): Stems ending in ㄹ take only -러, never -으러.
듣으러 (X) → 들으러 (O): In 듣다, 걷다 and 묻다, ㄷ changes to ㄹ before -으러.
돕으러 (X) → 도우러 (O): In 돕다, 줍다 and 굽다, ㅂ changes to 우. Then add -러.

task.title: Use -(으)러 correctly
task.line: Write the -(으)러 form of the verb given, or choose the one correct sentence.

exercises: Fill in the blank with 사다 (to buy) + -(으)러: 마트에 과일을 ____ 가요.
Fill in the blank with 찍다 (to take a photo) + -(으)러: 공원에 사진을 ____ 갔어요.
Fill in the blank with 팔다 (to sell) + -(으)러: 안 읽는 책을 ____ 서점에 가요.
Fill in the blank with 걷다 (to walk) + -(으)러: 저녁을 먹고 공원에 ____ 가요.
Fill in the blank with 줍다 (to pick up) + -(으)러: 주말에 바닷가에 쓰레기를 ____ 가요.
Choose the one correct sentence: (a) 운동하러 체육관에서 뛰어요. (b) 운동하러 체육관에 다녀요. (c) 체육관에 가러 가요. (d) 건강하러 체육관에 가요.
